message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features four men positioned behind a white table against a blue background. Across the top, white text reads "TEMPO" below a gray banner containing "EDISI KHUSUS PEMILIHAN PRESIDEN". 

From left to right: a man in a green shirt eats noodles from a white bowl decorated with a black rooster; he holds white chopsticks in his right hand. Beside him, a man in a black cap and orange shirt raises his right fist and holds a small blue container in his left hand. Next, a man in a light blue shirt holds his hands near his chest. On the far right, a man with white hair and a blue shirt raises clenched fists. 

The foreground table holds three additional rooster-motif bowls, two stacked and one separate, along with three white cups with black lids and scattered small brown shapes. 

Large blue text at the bottom reads "BOWO, JOKO, HATTA & KALLA." Smaller text below says "TELITI SEBELUM MEMILIH: YANG LURUS DAN YANG LANCUNG DARI CALON PRESIDEN DAN WAKIL PRESIDEN". A barcode and "RP 35.000" are also visible.
